purpose: Bounded development diagnosis; no held-out data, learning, or promotion
optional_trigger: Run only if at least 50% of canonical tangent_v2 ticks sample zero destination-pad pixels
stopping_rule: Stop each episode at first terminal state or 96 diagnostic ticks; a diagnostic cutoff is incomplete, never a scored timeout. Preserve every scheduled result and failure. No extensions or replacement seeds.
budget_basis: Historical 0.399 s median per call: about 613 s primary plus 306 s optional, with bounded load/runtime headroom. 96 ticks cover early drift and wall residence; do not estimate full-episode success rates from cutoffs.
